{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:36.358
    | text      = Every one of the new heart attack myocarditis cases in children,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:48.159

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:53.739
    | text      = You're like, "Why would you do something like that?"

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:58.418
    | text      = Oh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:58.719
    | text      = Because if you understand the mindset of why they do it, there, there's a philosophy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:04.739
    | text      = See, there's two types of knowledge. There's knowledge of good...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:07.458
    | text      = Oh, God, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:07.918
    | text      = ... and there's knowledge of evil. And, and knowledge means you understand how the systems work-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:10.958
    | text      = That's the same type of knowledge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:13.278
    | text      = One builds strength and beauty and honor and life and power and success,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:17.539
    | text      = the other, destruction and death and betrayal. But there are ways you can do things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:23.239
    | text      = And see, good people don't really have knowledge of evil.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:28.099
    | text      = Wait.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:28.398
    | text      = Which you could say is good at one level,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:30.938
    | text      = because when no one has knowledge of it, no one does it, and you just operate on as God designed you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:36.278
    | text      = But since evil's been introduced and evil systems developed and set up
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:40.679
    | text      = as perpetual motion machines, we need to stop being naive and face the horror.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:49.159
    | text      = If you want to dismantle the horror,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:53.918
    | text      = you don't make a friend of horror, as Colonel Kurtz says in Apocalypse Now,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:59.938
    | text      = you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:01.119
    | text      = make it your mortal enemy so that you can know it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:04.719
    | text      = uh, but then understand it and put yourself in its shoes, in its boots,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:12.918
    | text      = so you can understand why it's doing it. Because killing people is just part of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:17.498
    | text      = Oh.Okay. This is fun and all, and I'm- I'm sure it makes Alex feel cool to say, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:22.210

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:26.471
    | text      = mind, he's God's chosen soldier meant to fight the devil, and what makes him so

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
